title: Sequential Composition of Machine Runs
statement: Let $M$ and $N$ be Boolean machines with the same number $k$ of work tapes and state sets $S$ and $U$, respectively, with decidable equality on $S$. Suppose the run of $M$ from state $\mathrm{en}$ and tape assignment $w_0$ reaches state $\mathrm{ex}$ with assignment $w_1$ after $t_0$ steps, without visiting $\mathrm{ex}$ at any earlier time; and the run of $N$ from state $\mathrm{start}$ and assignment $w_1$ reaches state $\mathrm{finish}$ with assignment $w_2$ after $t_1$ steps, without visiting $\mathrm{finish}$ at any earlier time. Then the machine that runs $M$ until its exit state and then switches to $N$ reaches the right-hand copy of $\mathrm{finish}$ with assignment $w_2$ after $t_0+1+t_1$ steps, and does not visit that state at any earlier time.
